typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	sFilename as string (),
	tblEndurCommoditiesInterBookReconSummary_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		BOOK as string,
		NPV as string,
		{FOOTHILL NPV} as string,
		CASH as string,
		{DEAL COUNT} as string,
		Position as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> InterBookReconSummaryNONBsktBk	source(output(
		Filename as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> LookupLKPTABLE
InterBookReconSummaryNONBsktBk derive(LoadDate = toString((currentTimestamp())),
		Filename = toString(($sFilename))) ~> DerivedColumn
DerivedColumn derive({Copy of Filename} = Filename) ~> DataConversion
DataConversion,LookupLKPTABLE lookup({Copy of Filename} == LookupLKPTABLE@Filename,
	multiple: false,
	pickup: 'any',
	broadcast: 'none')~> Lookup
Lookup select(mapColumn(
		{Copy of Filename} = {Copy of Filename},
		Filename = LookupLKPTABLE@Filename,
		LoadDate = LoadDate,
		BOOK = BOOK,
		NPV = NPV,
		{FOOTHILL NPV} = {FOOTHILL NPV},
		CASH = CASH,
		{DEAL COUNT} = {DEAL COUNT},
		Position = Position
	),
	 skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	 skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true) ~> Lookup01
Lookup01 filter(!isMatch()) ~> Lookup0
Lookup0 sink(input(
		LastLoadDate as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		NPV as double,
		Position as double,
		BOOK as string,
		DEAL_COUNT as double,
		FileName as string,
		CASH as double,
		FOOTHILL_NPV as double
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		LastLoadDate = LoadDate,
		NPV,
		Position,
		BOOK,
		DEAL_COUNT = {DEAL COUNT},
		FileName = {Copy of Filename},
		CASH,
		FOOTHILL_NPV = {FOOTHILL NPV}),
	partitionFileNames:[($tblEndurCommoditiesInterBookReconSummary_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> tblEndurCommoditiesInterBookReconSummary
